[![Platform Compatibility](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fswiftpackageindex.com%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fgoogleapis%2Fswift-google-cloud-resourcemanager-v3%2Fbadge%3Ftype%3Dplatforms)](https://swiftpackageindex.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-resourcemanager-v3)

Creates, reads, and updates metadata for Google Cloud Platform resource
containers.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `FoldersClient`: Manages Cloud Platform folder resources. (Recommended starting point)
- `OrganizationsClient`: Allows users to manage their organization resources.
- `ProjectsClient`: Manages Google Cloud Projects.
- `TagBindingsClient`: Allow users to create and manage TagBindings between TagValues and different Google Cloud resources throughout the GCP resource hierarchy.
- `TagHoldsClient`: Allow users to create and manage TagHolds for TagValues.
- `TagKeysClient`: Allow users to create and manage tag keys.
- `TagValuesClient`: Allow users to create and manage tag values.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `FoldersClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudResourceManagerV3
import GoogleIAMV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(parent: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudResourceManagerV3.FoldersClient()
  let items = client.listFoldersByItems(
    request: ListFoldersRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "\(parent)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-resourcemanager-v3` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-resourcemanager-v3.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudResourceManagerV3` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudResourceManagerV3 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-resourcemanager-v3
```
